bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: lifecycleScope should be Lifecycle
App crashes immediately on first launch after adding setup screen — NPE on _binding!! in HomeFragment.observeData()
bugs.root_cause: HomeFragment is the nav start destination so it creates its view immediately. MainActivity then navigates to SetupFragment, destroying HomeFragment's view (_binding = null). The StateFlow collectors launched with viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch { collectLatest } have a race window where one final emission can fire after onDestroyView() before the scope fully cancels.
bugs.fix: Wrapped both collectors inside viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED). This suspends the entire block when the fragment stops and resumes it when it starts again — no emission can reach the binding access while the view is destroyed.

bugs.error_message: Kugou song starts playing correctly but immediately times out and skips: 'Playback timeout: wrong song playing! Expected ABC君, actual 有心的定不止五六个'

PlaybackService.schedulePlaybackTimeout used the metadata title to verify the playing song; for Kugou the title flips to a lyric line within ~1-2 seconds, triggering the wrong-song-playing branch and a spurious skip.
bugs.fix: Extended the NetEase-only title-verification exemption to also cover Platforms.KUGOU. Hoisted titleCyclesLyrics out of the isPlaying block so the play-nudge branch (when position<1000ms) also bypasses title matching for both platforms.

bugs.error_message: Visible flash when switching songs in background mode — music app briefly appears at HyperOS default centered freeform bounds before resize lands off-screen
bugs.root_cause: am start --windowingMode 5 creates a fresh freeform task at HyperOS-default centered bounds (Rect(279,698,801,1778)) and renders the activity there before our follow-up am task resize moves it off-screen. The user sees the centered window for ~180ms before it disappears.
bugs.fix: Single shell script atomically decides between two paths: (1) REUSE if a visible freeform task for the target package already exists — deliver the deep link via plain am start without --windowingMode 5, intent goes through onNewIntent without creating a new task or changing windowing mode, zero flash; (2) COLD if no existing task — am start --windowingMode 5 + inline poll-and-resize in the same shell (one binder IPC, 10ms polling), reduces flash window to ~30-50ms vs. the prior 180ms. The cold-path flash is unavoidable for the very first launch after a force-stop / reboot, but every subsequent switch (95% of switches in normal use) takes the REUSE path.

bugs.error_message: Floating-window progress percent stuck at 0% (mini-ball ring + expanded seekbar) without Shizuku; song title still shows correctly. Intermittent — sometimes self-recovers.
bugs.root_cause: Commit 159c7f9 (background mode + Shizuku) added rebindMediaMonitorIfNeeded() because HyperOS leaves the NotificationListenerService unbound after APK reinstall / process kill, even though the permission still shows granted. The Shizuku path (`cmd notification disallow_listener/allow_listener`) is reliable. The Java fallback was just `NotificationListenerService.requestRebind()`, which the commit itself flagged as unreliable on HyperOS. When the rebind silently failed, MediaMonitorService had no activeControllers → getPlaybackInfo() returned null → floating-window progress stuck at 0%. Song title is unaffected because it's populated from the Music Hub song record, not from MediaSession metadata.
bugs.fix: Before calling requestRebind in the Java fallback, toggle the MediaMonitorService component's enabled state via PackageManager.setComponentEnabledSetting(DISABLED, DONT_KILL_APP) then (ENABLED, DONT_KILL_APP). The disable+enable forces the system to drop the stale binding and re-establish it, which is the standard non-Shizuku workaround for notification listeners failing to rebind on MIUI/HyperOS. Verified on device: force-stop → relaunch → logcat shows 'Toggled component state and requested rebind' immediately followed by 'NotificationListener connected' + controllers added for all 4 platforms within ~1s.

bugs.error_message: Bilibili videos (BV/av) often fail to advance to the next song when finished — Bilibili keeps playing the same content (auto-loop).
bugs.root_cause: Bilibili's video player auto-loops the video at end-of-content. The MediaSession stays in STATE_PLAYING (no state transition) and the metadata stays the same (no duration change), so neither isSongFinished (state-transition path) nor onMetadataChanged (metadata-change path) fires. The pollCurrentPosition early-end path needs the strict isBilibiliNearEnd (percentPlayed >= 99.8% AND remaining <= 3000ms) to be hit within a 1-second poll window — easy to miss for typical-length videos. Net result: no song-end detection → Music Hub never advances → eventually falls through to the timeout-skip path or never advances.
bugs.fix: Added an explicit Bilibili-loop detection branch to pollCurrentPosition: if maxPositionReached >= 95% of duration AND estimatedPosition < 10% of duration AND state is still PLAYING AND not in manual control, treat as song-end. The 95% max-position guard prevents false-triggering on user-initiated seek-to-start (would require watching 95% then seeking to start). This catches the loop signal that none of the three standard paths can see.

bugs.error_message: Consecutive NetEase songs no longer enter PlayerLandscapeActivity in foreground mode when phone is held landscape — song 1 works, song 2+ load portrait PlayerActivity.
bugs.root_cause: Commit 6cef8fe added a 'pause storm' (6 scheduled pauses at 500-1500ms) + armSamePlatformNetEasePause() to suppress NetEase's auto-advanced 'third song' on same-platform NetEase switches. The new block was added WITHOUT the !isLandscapeForDoubleSend gate that the original beeb116 re-send block has. In landscape mode for song 2+: armSamePlatformNetEasePause opens a 2500ms reactive-pause window in MediaMonitorService. When CLEAR_TASK destroys NetEase and the fresh PlayerActivity reports the target song's first STATE_PLAYING at position ~0 within that window, the reactive-pause branch in onPlaybackStateChanged fires pause+stop and `return`s early — skipping the firePendingPlaybackCallback block that would call restoreAutoRotation. Device stays in portrait (ACCELEROMETER_ROTATION=0, USER_ROTATION=0), NetEase loads PlayerActivity (portrait), never opens PlayerLandscapeActivity. The 15s LANDSCAPE_ROTATION_TIMEOUT_MS fallback eventually fires but by then the user has been staring at a portrait screen. Song 1 works because isSamePlatformNetEase requires lastLaunchedPlatform==NETEASE which is only true from song 2 onward.
bugs.fix: Gated the pause-storm block on `!isLandscapeForDoubleSend`, matching the re-send block (which was already correctly gated). Rationale (echoing beeb116's comment, still in the file at the re-send block): CLEAR_TASK destroys NetEase's queue, so there's no auto-advance to suppress in landscape — the pause storm is redundant there and only hurts the rotation callback.

bugs.error_message: 无障碍服务权限 silently disabled — user finds it ungranted after every app 'restart'. Originally suspected to be HyperOS-specific (notified_non_accessibility_category_services audit, or PACKAGE_CHANGED audit). Final reproducible cause: `am force-stop` (or any equivalent — HyperOS Clear-all, Recents swipe-up close, background-task killer, manual force-stop from App info) sets the package to `stopped=true`, after which AccessibilityManagerService excludes the package's services from the next service-enumeration sweep and removes them from `Settings.Secure.enabled_accessibility_services` within ~50-200 ms.
bugs.root_cause: Standard AOSP behavior in `AccessibilityManagerService.onSomePackagesChanged()`: services whose owning package is `stopped=true` are filtered out of `installedServices`, then any matching component is dropped from `enabled_accessibility_services`. Re-launching the app clears the stopped flag but does NOT restore the setting. Verified empirically: (1) every app on the device experiences this — `am force-stop com.mutangtech.qianji` (Xiaomi-market-installed app) removed its SelectToSpeak service exactly the same way; (2) the pre-background-mode Music Hub `v0.0.0-14-gfcf40b2` (single QQ-Music-only accessibility config, before 159c7f9) also loses accessibility on force-stop, so the regression theory was wrong — it never worked across force-stop. The earlier hypotheses (HyperOS PACKAGE_CHANGED audit from setComponentEnabledSetting; notified_non_accessibility_category_services category audit) are real but separate, much rarer mechanisms — the everyday cause is plain force-stop. Triggers that do NOT disable: `am kill`, backgrounding via Home, APK reinstall, idle for 30+ s. Triggers that DO disable: `am force-stop`, HyperOS 'Clear all' in Recents, HyperOS background-task killer, Recents swipe-up close on HyperOS, manual force-stop from App info.
bugs.fix: Two parts. (1) Defense-in-depth split of the single accessibility service into PlayerAccessibilityService (QQ Music only; canRetrieveWindowContent + canPerformGestures; narrow event types) and FreeformResizeAccessibilityService (4 music apps; canRetrieveWindowContent=false + canPerformGestures=false; only TYPE_WINDOWS_CHANGED) — reduces audit profile and blast radius if the category audit ever does fire. (2) Auto-restore via Shizuku: track per-service grant in SharedPreferences ('musichub_a11y') whenever we observe the service enabled; on subsequent app launches, if a tracked service is missing from enabled_accessibility_services, call ShizukuLauncher.restoreAccessibilityServices() which reads the current setting, appends our missing services (preserving any third-party entries), and writes the merged list back via shell (`settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services ...` + `accessibility_enabled 1`). Writing the setting needs WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS — granted to shell UID and accessible via Shizuku. Users without Shizuku still need manual re-enable. The previously-explored 'avoid setComponentEnabledSetting toggle to suppress PACKAGE_CHANGED' fix was based on a wrong hypothesis and was reverted; the toggle is still useful for the NotificationListener rebind and isn't the trigger for accessibility loss.

bugs.error_message: Brief 'third song' audio leak (~44 ms of NetEase's queued next track) during NetEase→NetEase landscape transitions
bugs.root_cause: doLaunchSong gated both armSamePlatformNetEasePause() and the 6 scheduled pausePackage() calls behind !isLandscapeForDoubleSend. The 2026-05-16 do-not-repeat assumed CLEAR_TASK destroyed NetEase's queue so the pause storm was redundant in landscape — empirically wrong. CLEAR_TASK destroys the activity but not NetEase's persisted internal queue; the fresh PlayerActivity reads it on creation and audibly plays the queue's next item for ~44 ms before processing the deep link's onNewIntent.
bugs.fix: Split the gated block. The 6 scheduled pauses (500/700/900/1100/1300/1500 ms post-deep-link) now run in both portrait and landscape — they're direct pause+stop on NetEase's MediaSession via pausePackage() and don't touch samePlatformNetEasePauseUntil or pendingPlaybackCallback, so they can't short-circuit firePendingPlaybackCallback → restoreAutoRotation. armSamePlatformNetEasePause() stays portrait-only because its early `return` in onPlaybackStateChanged would block restoreAutoRotation if the target song's STATE_PLAYING falls inside its 2500 ms window.
